guide.summary: University monuments, museums, gardens and family sights, with hotel restaurants, cafés and bars checked against their own websites or the public bodies that run them.
highlights: Monastery of Santa Clara-a-Nova (Igreja da Rainha Santa Isabel)
guide.tip: Buy your Joanina Library ticket ahead, because it fixes a date and entry time at purchase, and note that the University monuments close on 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 and 1 January 2027, while UC Exploratório closes on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The University of Coimbra monuments open every day but close on 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 and 1 January 2027, and UC Exploratório's agenda marks Mondays as closed. Portugal dos Pequenitos lists 25 December as its closing day.

toolkit.label: Timed tickets
toolkit.copy: A Joanina Library ticket carries a date and time chosen at purchase, while other non-guided University tickets stay valid for two days. The Joanina Library + University + Science Museum programme costs €16.50 for adults, and no refunds are accepted.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Passaporte Coimbra takes restaurant reservations online, by phone or by email, and Arcadas at Quinta das Lágrimas books through LaFourchette or CoverManager. Quinta das Lágrimas serves Brunch at the Palace every Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 to 15:00, bookable by phone or email.

toolkit.label: House rules
toolkit.copy: Photography and filming are prohibited on the Joanina Library's Noble Floor, and flash is banned inside all University visiting spaces. Passaporte Coimbra admits only guests aged 12 and over.

guide.dek: Book your Joanina Library slot first, then build the rest of the day around it and the University's 17:00 closing.
intro: Start on the hill at the University of Coimbra, where the ticket office sits on Rua Larga. The Joanina Library, the Royal Palace and Saint Michael's Chapel open every day from 9:00 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 17:00, and a Joanina ticket carries a fixed date and time chosen when you buy it. The Joanina Library + University + Science Museum programme costs €16.50 for adults and is listed as valid until 31 December 2027. Photography and filming are prohibited on the Joanina's Noble Floor, flash is banned in all visiting spaces, and the University closes on 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 and 1 January 2027.

Below the Palace of Schools, the Botanical Garden of the University of Coimbra keeps winter hours of 9:00 to 17:30 from 1 October to 31 March, and visits go ahead whatever the weather. Facing the garden on Rua da Infantaria, the Casa-Museu Bissaya Barreto opened Marcelo Moscheta's exhibition "Natura Naturata" on 31 October 2026, and the Casa das Artes Bissaya Barreto on Rua Castro Matoso opened Ana Frois's "Pêndulo" the same afternoon. From 10 November 2026 until December 2027, the Arquivo Histórico Municipal at the Casa Municipal da Cultura shows a free exhibition on Coimbra's municipal government, Monday to Friday.

Across the Mondego in Santa Clara, Portugal dos Pequenitos sells tickets online and lists 25 December as its closing day, with last entry 30 minutes before closing. UC Exploratório, the University's science centre in the Parque Verde do Mondego, gives hours of 10:00 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 18:00 from Tuesday to Sunday on its agenda and marks Mondays as closed. Higher up stands the Monastery of Santa Clara-a-Nova, home to the Igreja da Rainha Santa Isabel.

For evenings, Passaporte Coimbra on Rua da Couraça da Estrela opens every day, with the restaurant serving from 19:00 to 23:00 and the cocktail bar running from 17:00 to 02:00; entry is for ages 12 and up. At Quinta das Lágrimas, you can book Arcadas online, while Pedro e Inês opens only for breakfast and lunch and the hotel serves Brunch at the Palace on Saturdays and Sundays from 12:00 to 15:00, at €27 for adults. In the Baixa, Café Santa Cruz's own site lists free fado sessions at 18:00 and 22:00, with no 22:00 session on Sundays, though its newest dated item is from 2023.
summaryCards: Start at the University of Coimbra with a timed Joanina Library ticket, then walk down through the Botanical Garden.
Take breakfast at Versátil in the Vila Galé Coimbra from 07:00 to 10:30, or book the weekend Brunch at the Palace at Quinta das Lágrimas.
The University monuments close on 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 and 1 January 2027, and UC Exploratório closes on Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read: Museu Nacional de Machado de Castro (connection closed), Santa Clara-a-Velha (culturacentro.gov.pt DNS failure), Conímbriga (connection refused), À Capella (connection reset), Convento São Francisco, cm-coimbra.pt, uc.pt/jardimbotanico, uc.pt/museudaciencia, NH Hotels and bellaciao.pt (403), Dux (certificate error) and Basófias (server error); these are not evidence of closure. Mercado Municipal D. Pedro V, Torre de Almedina, Edifício Chiado and Casa-Museu Miguel Torga have current council news but no published address. Many well-known Baixa restaurants, pastry shops and cafés (Solar do Bacalhau, Zé Manel dos Ossos, Pastelaria Briosa, NAU Coffee) have no official website, so no bakery other than Café Santa Cruz could be confirmed. Hours are partial: no times are published for the Casa-Museu, Arcadas, Pedro e Inês, the Hotel Oslo rooftop bar, TAGV's box office or the Quinta das Lágrimas gardens. Portugal dos Pequenitos' hours page is undated, Café Santa Cruz's and UC Exploratório's ticket pages date from 2023, and A Tasca das Tias Camellas' page carries no current date. The University's tourism page describes UC Exploratório as open daily, while UC Exploratório's own agenda lists it as closed on Mondays; this guide follows the venue's own agenda.
